prompt.name: Worker
prompt.look: a rugged quarry labourer in a hand-painted historical strategy style: bare-headed with short dark hair and a red cloth headband, a plain cream linen tunic with short sleeves and a red cloth belt, rough brown trousers and leather boots, and nothing else carried; he holds one realistic short-handled iron pickaxe in his right hand, the wooden handle only about as long as his arm and a half (roughly from his hip to his shoulder), held upright at chest height with the curved iron pick head at the top, nothing like a staff; facing right, legs clearly apart in a wide stance with a visible gap between the feet, both legs straight and not touching
prompt.team_area: the red headband and the belt
prompt.identity: the same labourer, headband, tunic, belt, boots and pickaxe
